approximateLocation: Lower Richardson Lake at Middle Dam, Andover / Rangeley Lakes Region, western Maine
listingFacts: Lakewood Camps is a sporting camp by Lower Richardson Lake and the Rapid River, offering cabins, fly fishing and hunting. Guests normally arrive by boat. Current original site, checked 2026-11-04: 174th season May 14–June 30, 2027; two-person cabin $500/night, four-person $1,000/night; meals and incidentals $60/person/night; two-night minimum. A 50% deposit is required, balance due 60 days before arrival. Its general hunting FAQ conflicts with a notice of fall improvements; verify availability with the operator. These are source details, not an approved LAZY quote.
hostStory: The original business website dates the camp to 1853. Association with Al is user-reported. Do not infer a precise legal ownership role or management team from the camp name.
focus: Fishing, hunting, cabins, dining and boat arrival
homeContent: Existing redesign includes Home, The Camp, Fishing, Hunting, Wildlife, Plan Your Trip, Rates and Events. Source assets and design working files are retained in liza-bam/Lakewood. The repository's original-site content snapshot is historical, not current booking terms.
